svg.title: What to Put in Your AGENTS.md So Your Agent Handles the Database Right
svg.desc: An ink code card with an AGENTS.md filename tab holding the post's five database rules, with the npx create-db@latest --json line marked in prism yellow. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: - Scratch work gets a throwaway database:
- Never reset or drop without my confirmation.
- Rehearse migrations on a throwaway first.
- Prefer --json output when a CLI offers it.
- Keep connection strings in the environment.
